title: Organisation portal

gate.title: For sponsoring organisations
gate.body: Employers, schools and insurers who offer Living Dose to their people can see anonymised wellbeing totals here.
gate.live: Our team sets up access for your organisation's administrators. Contact us to get started.
gate.demo: Demo mode: choose a sample organisation to try the portal.

privacy: Anonymised totals only. You never see anyone's individual results, and figures for fewer than 5 people are hidden.

sample.label: Show sample data
sample.note: Sample data: 140 fictional people, for previewing the portal. Turn off to see your real totals.

overview.title: Wellbeing overview
overview.suppressedBody: To protect privacy, totals appear once at least 10 people have taken the health check. {{count}} more needed.

riskNames.diabetes: Moderate or higher type 2 diabetes risk

overview.prioritiesHint: Share of people whose health check put this in their top 3.
overview.programmesBody: Our dietitians and doctors can run talks, cooking workshops and screening days built around these priorities.
overview.programmesCta: Talk to us about a programme
overview.failed: The totals couldn't be loaded. Check your connection and refresh.

invite.title: Invite your people
invite.intro: Share this code. People join from My account → Organisation, and choose to be counted in your anonymised totals.
invite.message: We've partnered with Living Dose to support your health. Sign up free at livingdose.netlify.app, take the 5-minute health check, then go to My account → Organisation and enter the code {{code}}. Your personal results stay private to you: we only ever see anonymised totals for the whole group.
invite.steps: How it works for your people
stepsItems: They sign up and take the free health check.
They enter your code in My account → Organisation and agree to be counted.
They get meal plans, the shop, experts and community, like every member.
They can leave your organisation at any time.

member.title: Organisation
member.intro: If your employer, school or insurer offers Living Dose, join with their code.
member.consent: I agree that my health check results can be included in anonymised totals for this organisation. They will never see my individual results.

errors.code: We don't recognise that code. Check it with your organisation.
errors.consent: Please tick the box to agree before joining.
errors.failed: That didn't go through. Check your connection and try again.

member.whatSharedBody: Only totals for the whole group, such as the average Living Score, and only when at least 10 people have taken the health check. Never your name, answers or results.
member.leaveConfirm: Leave {{name}}? Your results will no longer be counted in their totals.
